description: Java class ReportReader for parsing and processing report data files related to engine parameters such as RPM and MAF, including filtering and mapping data.

classes.name: ReportReader
classes.description: Main class for reading, filtering, and mapping report data files containing engine parameter logs.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initiates reading a specific report file.

methods.name: readMap
methods.description: Reads a report file, filters data, finds min/max values, and returns a map of RPM to MAF to ReportLine.

methods.name: asMap
methods.description: Converts a list of ReportLine objects into a nested map structure keyed by RPM and MAF.

methods.name: findMinMax
methods.description: Calculates and logs the minimum and maximum values for MAF and RPM from the report lines.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters out report lines with invalid RPM differences.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads report lines from a file and parses them into ReportLine objects.

methods.name: handleOneLine
methods.description: Parses a single line of report data into a ReportLine object if it matches the pattern.
